title: Decoding Labels
summary: Convert a whole SPSS file's labels with as_factor() and see what happens to user-missing codes.
hints: `teach_f <- as_factor(teach)` converts every labelled column in one go.
Count a category by comparing with its label: `sum(teach_f$method == "Active learning")`.
The "No answer" code (9) was declared missing in SPSS, so it arrives as NA: `sum(is.na(teach$anxiety))`.
